batch_identity.sam3_reuse: one shared lane, never restarted mid-batch

notes: prefill_ladder_plain matches the planner's non-streaming mode; ladder_stream adds TTFB.
All coefficients are medians of repeated identical requests on this gateway, from this container, because the latency distribution is right-skewed.
These coefficients are applied to episode data as DERIVED values only; the episodes themselves expose neither a first-token marker nor a server-side stage breakdown.
refit: coefficients on the MINIMUM of repeats (least-contended sample), because medians on this gateway are queue-noise dominated; medians are retained for the tail story only.
All durations are host wall time; nested spans are reported as sum_ms and union_ms.
llm.response spans come from non-streaming requests, so server-side prefill and hidden thinking are not separable from the client; only the request wall time and token counters are measured.
SAM3 spans carry no episode key (one shared lane), so they are attributed by the episode execution window.
